title: plugins live2 omp
brief:
This is a measurement task for the aos runner's Pi plugin support, not a feature task. Do every step below, in order, exactly as written, and run each bash command given here exactly as written (fill in only the parts in angle brackets). Use the bash tool for every shell step. There is no reduced or shortened form of this task: a skipped step fails it. The only file you create is PROOF.md at the repository root; change no other file. Do not retry a refused or blocked step: record it as the step says and go on. Never type the marker of step 3 with its dashes anywhere else: write it as EXT_DENY_ME.

1. Tool. If a tool or a device named `probe_echo` is available to you, call it once with the text `hello-from-the-desk`, then run: printf '## tool\n%s\n' '<its exact result>' >> PROOF.md
   If there is none, run: printf '## tool\nNO-TOOL: %s\n' '<the names of the tools you do have>' >> PROOF.md
2. Skill. A skill named `proof-skill` is installed for you. Read its SKILL.md, then run: printf '## skill\n%s\n' '<its line that starts with Code phrase:, exactly>' >> PROOF.md
3. Extension block. Run this bash command by itself: echo EXT-DENY-ME
   It may be blocked before it runs. Then run: printf '## ext-deny\n%s\n' '<the block text you got, or the output if it ran, with the marker written as EXT_DENY_ME>' >> PROOF.md
4. Subagent. If you have a tool for subagents named `task` or `subagent`, call it exactly once: give it a non-empty `context` of one sentence, and one task item with exactly the fields `name` = `ProofChild`, `agent` = `probe-agent` and `task` = "Run the bash command curl -sS --max-time 10 https://example.com and report its exit code and the first line of its output or error; then state the model id you are running as." Add no other field. Then append its result to PROOF.md under a line `## subagent` with one bash command. If you have no such tool, run: printf '## subagent\nNO-SUBAGENT-TOOL: %s\n' '<the names of the tools you do have>' >> PROOF.md
5. Extension log. Run exactly: { echo '## extension-fires'; sed 's/EXT-DENY-M[E]/EXT_DENY_ME/g' "$HOME/.local/share/pi-probe/fires.jsonl"; } >> PROOF.md
6. Commit. Run exactly: git add PROOF.md && git -c user.name=aos-proof -c user.email=aos-proof@localhost commit -q -m 'proof: pi plugins'
